query.description: Chain 묶기 화면: E-Test Chain(측정 항목에서 추출) + 묶음 번호 / 묶음 Chain 목록 / 묶음 수
query.commandtext: WITH C AS (SELECT UPPER(CHAIN_NAME) AS CHAIN_KEY, ET_ITEM_SEQ FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :f1 AND DEVICE_ID = :d1 UNION ALL SELECT UPPER(CHAIN_NAME2), ET_ITEM_SEQ FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :f2 AND DEVICE_ID = :d2 AND CHAIN_NAME2 IS NOT NULL), CC AS (SELECT CHAIN_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT ET_ITEM_SEQ) AS ITEM_COUNT FROM C GROUP BY CHAIN_KEY), G AS (SELECT T.*, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY T.GROUP_SEQ) AS GROUP_COUNT, LISTAGG(T.CHAIN_NAME, ' + ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY T.CHAIN_NAME) OVER (PARTITION BY T.GROUP_SEQ) AS GROUP_CHAINS FROM TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_GROUP T WHERE T.FACTORY = :f3 AND T.DEVICE_ID = :d3) SELECT NVL(CC.CHAIN_KEY, G.CHAIN_NAME) AS CHAIN_NAME, NVL(CC.ITEM_COUNT, 0) AS ITEM_COUNT, G.GROUP_SEQ, NVL(G.GROUP_COUNT, 0) AS GROUP_COUNT, G.GROUP_CHAINS, G.REMARK, NVL(G.UPDATE_USER, G.CREATE_USER) AS UPDATE_USER, NVL(G.UPDATE_TIME, G.CREATE_TIME) AS UPDATE_TIME FROM CC FULL OUTER JOIN G ON G.CHAIN_NAME = CC.CHAIN_KEY ORDER BY NVL(CC.CHAIN_KEY, G.CHAIN_NAME)

query.description: Setup Chain 목록: Factory 의 GDS Chain 이름 (현재 READY 버전)
query.commandtext: SELECT DEVICE_ID, CHAIN_NAME FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN_VER WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND IS_CURRENT = 1 AND VERSION_STATUS = 'READY' GROUP BY DEVICE_ID, CHAIN_NAME ORDER BY CHAIN_NAME, DEVICE_ID

query.description: Setup Chain 이름 -> E-Test Chain (이름이 같으면 EXACT, 이름_FH / 이름_FL 이면 SUFFIX) + 묶음 번호. 측정 항목 / 묶음 / Spec 의 Chain 에서 찾는다
query.commandtext: WITH E AS (SELECT UPPER(CHAIN_NAME) AS C FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :f1 AND DEVICE_ID = :d1 UNION SELECT UPPER(CHAIN_NAME2) FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :f2 AND DEVICE_ID = :d2 AND CHAIN_NAME2 IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT CHAIN_NAME FROM TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_GROUP WHERE FACTORY = :f3 AND DEVICE_ID = :d3 UNION SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(ITEM_NAME, '@([^:]+)', 1, 1, NULL, 1) FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT WHERE FACTORY = :f4 AND DEVICE_ID = :d4 UNION SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(ITEM_NAME, '@[^:]+:(.+)$', 1, 1, NULL, 1) FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT WHERE FACTORY = :f5 AND DEVICE_ID = :d5) SELECT E.C AS CHAIN_NAME, CASE WHEN E.C = :k1 THEN 'EXACT' ELSE 'SUFFIX' END AS MATCH_TYPE, G.GROUP_SEQ FROM E LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_GROUP G ON G.FACTORY = :f6 AND G.DEVICE_ID = :d6 AND G.CHAIN_NAME = E.C WHERE E.C IN (:k2, :k3 || '_FH', :k4 || '_FL') ORDER BY E.C
SELECT CHAIN_NAME, GROUP_SEQ FROM TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_GROUP WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND GROUP_SEQ = TO_NUMBER(:group_seq) ORDER BY CHAIN_NAME
SELECT ET_CHAIN_GROUP_SEQ.NEXTVAL AS GROUP_SEQ FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= TO_NUMBER(:group_count)

query.description: Chain 을 묶음에 넣는다 (이미 다른 묶음이면 옮김, InsertExecuteMultiple)
query.commandtext: MERGE INTO TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_GROUP T USING (SELECT :factory AS FACTORY, :device_id AS DEVICE_ID, :chain_name AS CHAIN_NAME, TO_NUMBER(:group_seq) AS GROUP_SEQ, :remark AS REMARK, :update_user AS UPDATE_USER FROM DUAL) S ON (T.FACTORY = S.FACTORY AND T.DEVICE_ID = S.DEVICE_ID AND T.CHAIN_NAME = S.CHAIN_NAME) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.GROUP_SEQ = S.GROUP_SEQ, T.REMARK = S.REMARK, T.UPDATE_USER = S.UPDATE_USER, T.UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, CHAIN_NAME, GROUP_SEQ, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (S.FACTORY, S.DEVICE_ID, S.CHAIN_NAME, S.GROUP_SEQ, S.REMARK, S.UPDATE_USER, SYSDATE, S.UPDATE_USER, SYSDATE)

query.description: Chain 을 옮긴 뒤 1개만 남은 묶음 정리
query.commandtext: DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_GROUP WHERE FACTORY = :f1 AND DEVICE_ID = :d1 AND GROUP_SEQ IN (SELECT GROUP_SEQ FROM TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_GROUP WHERE FACTORY = :f2 AND DEVICE_ID = :d2 GROUP BY GROUP_SEQ HAVING COUNT(*) < 2)

query.description: 묶음 해제: Chain 이 들어 있는 묶음 전체를 지운다
query.commandtext: DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_GROUP WHERE FACTORY = :f1 AND DEVICE_ID = :d1 AND GROUP_SEQ = (SELECT GROUP_SEQ FROM TQP_GDS_ET_CHAIN_GROUP WHERE FACTORY = :f2 AND DEVICE_ID = :d2 AND CHAIN_NAME = :chain_name)
